title: deploymentExecution
responsibility: Installs, checks, builds, uploads and health-checks an immutable source before recording its receipt.

inputs.name: deploymentExecution.reviewed
inputs.description: Reviewed deployment plan with repository, target, configuration hash and predecessor receipt.

inputs.name: deploymentExecution.runtime
inputs.description: Deployment adapter and injected execution, health and progress callbacks.

outputs.name: deploymentExecution
outputs.description: Verified deployment receipt; failures leave the destination receipt unadvanced.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Rejects unsafe source, target or promotion state; no successful deployment receipt is recorded.
